channel.title: Titel Media GmbH - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Titel Media GmbH (highsnobiety.com)

item.title: Nike's Ultra-Luxe Habanero Skate Shoe Is Almost Too Spicy
item.description: Paul Rodriguez's Nike SB Zoom Air skate shoe is a fire thrasher that's almost too luxe to shred in.

item.title: Like Beautiful Baskets For the Feet, These adidas Are Woven to Perfection
item.description: Exclusive to Japan, the adidas Gazelle Lo Pro Wonder White/Earth Strata/Off White is one of our favorite iterations of the silhouette so far.

item.title: These Butter-Soft Superstars Are So Luxe But Still Down to "Earth"
item.description: It’s so refreshing to see amazing new colorways like the adidas Originals Superstar II Earth Strata still hitting shelves.

item.title: These Dressy Dad Sandals Are Convertible (EXCLUSIVE)
item.description: Craig Green's Grenson sandals & dress shoes are British-made & strappy AF, with the elderly slides morphing as the wearer adjusts the snaps.

item.title: His Clothes Are Wearable Art. Now, He's Making Art Wearable
item.description: For 16 Years, Jan-Jan Van Essche has been creating the most beautiful clothes in this industry we call fashion. We spoke with the Belgian designer in interview.

item.title: After Years of Military-Coded New Balances, WTAPS Devised a Pared-Back Beauty
item.description: Just when you think you have WTAPS and New Balance’s sneakers all figured out, the Japanese fashion label springs up with a brilliantly blacked-out 1300 shoe.

item.title: The Designer of the iPhone Created a Surprisingly Analog Electric Ferrari
item.description: The Ferrari Luce electric car was designed in collaboration with LoveFrom, an agency by iPhone designer Jony Ive. But it's more analog than you'd expect.
